# growthbook_saved_group (Data Source)

Looks up a GrowthBook saved group by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "growthbook_saved_group" "beta_users" {
  id = "sg_abc123"
}

output "beta_users_values" {
  value = data.growthbook_saved_group.beta_users.values
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) GrowthBook saved group id.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the saved group is archived.
- `attribute_key` (String) Attribute key the group's list of values is based on, when `type = "list"`. References an attribute defined in the organization (see `growthbook_attribute`).
- `condition` (String) JSON-encoded condition for the group, when `type = "condition"`.
- `date_created` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the saved group was created.
- `date_updated` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the saved group was last updated.
- `description` (String) Description of the saved group.
- `name` (String) Display name of the saved group.
- `owner` (String) The userId of the owner.
- `owner_email` (String) Email address of the owner, when it can be resolved to a known user.
- `projects` (Set of String) Project ids this saved group is scoped to.
- `type` (String) Saved group type: `condition` or `list`.
- `use_empty_list_group` (Boolean) GrowthBook-managed flag for empty list-group handling.
- `values` (Set of String) List of attribute values, when `type = "list"`.
